rows.en: If he's vanished… you can't exactly take him back, can you?
He's vanished! What are you going to do?

Silence!

Mission complete… We had top-priority orders to use the last resort if Kitahara could not be secured!

Kitahara is dead! In the end, it comes to the same thing…

No point lingering here! We're going back!
Wait! What on earth is this "last resort"?
Wait! What do you mean by "last resort"?
…I'm under no obligation to answer! Let's go!
Heeey, is everyone all right?
Everyone, I'm so glad…
Ueno, thank you…
Oka, thank you!
Captain…
Go! Thank you, truly!
Yes, Captain…
…!? Sis!
You're all right now…
Lovely weather… See? Take a look.
…The sky's blue, isn't it? I can tell without looking.
A blue sky…
Pigeons! Can you see them, sis?
Ultraman had appeared in MAT's battles too. Captain Kato was grateful to his excellent rookie, Hideki Go.
He had a feeling… that Go had called Ultraman to them.
From then on, the new Ultraman would join MAT in its battles. Alongside the Science Patrol, MAT achieved one success after another.
Ultraman does not appear easily. Only when humans have used every ounce of their strength and fought to their very limit does he lend his power. And today, too, MAT pushes its limits!
I'll crush you with the invincible Red Baron!!
Go get 'em! Giant Robo!!
Let's go! One-Seven!!
Director…!
Mmh… MAT is hereby disbanded, effective immediately!!
Defeat all of Makuu, Madou and Fuuma!
Defeat the oil monster Takkong and all of Makuu, Madou and Fuuma!
Defeat the skull monster Red King and all of Makuu, Madou and Fuuma!
Defeat all of Makuu, Madou and Fuuma, and rescue Jimmy Kitahara!
Defeat the oil monster Takkong and all of Makuu, Madou and Fuuma, and rescue Jimmy Kitahara!
All allies are destroyed
All allies are destroyed, or the dynamite factory cannot be defended
You called for me, Fuhrer Geisel…
Udesper… Hurry and eliminate [VAR6]!

Leave it to me…

I've been waiting eagerly for that order to come down. [VAR6] will die by my own hand, without fail…
The day after Udesper received Fuhrer Geisel's orders, Goro Watari and the secret agent Makoto Arai had joined the forensics team to examine a body washed up on the beach…
…So he was one of the Desper Army's people, after all?
He must have escaped from their work site… and been killed when the escape failed!
If we trace the current back… we might be able to pinpoint their work site.
Mm…
Fufufu… They've come, just as calculated. Your turn… go!
Help me!!
A woman's being attacked!? Mr. Arai!
Right, let's save her!
Now, get away while you can!

Hey, are you all right!?

She's unconscious… Let's take her somewhere she can rest.

Hey, are you all right!?

She's unconscious… Let's take her somewhere she can rest.

Hey, are you all right!?

She's unconscious… Let's take her somewhere she can rest.

Hey, are you all right? Hang in there!

She's unconscious, but she doesn't seem hurt. Let's take her somewhere she can rest.
Goro Watari… You're prey, caught in my trap!
How is she?
It must have been quite a shock… She still hasn't said a word.

I see…

As it happens… this is what was on her camera.
This photo…!? The Desper Army's work site!
I think she was targeted because she photographed this site…
The man whose body washed ashore… could he have been forced to work here?

Well, most likely…

But… we'll have to hide this young lady somewhere.

Now that she knows their secret, the Desper Army will hunt her to the ends of the earth!
I know a good place…
You'll be safe here! No killers will come here.
Tomorrow, I'll go to the site in the photo. I might find some clue.
"I am Staff Officer Udesper's hound. My mission is to tell Staff Officer Udesper where the prey is hiding…"
A transmission from the female spy! She seems to be with Goro Watari.
Location?
East-southeast, 30.5 degrees, at a distance of 75 kilometers.

Mm… So that's their hideout?

Right… Prepare to launch missiles!
Missiles, sir? But No. 8001 is…
You needn't worry about that! Fire the missiles!
Hm, that sound!? Mr. Arai, missiles!
Take cover!
Kuh… Damn you, Udesper!! How did they find this place?
Me… they tried to kill me too!?

Ah, hey!?

Where are you going? Wait!
Hm!? So you've shown up, Desper Army!

uncertain: U06179: 最終手段 rendered 'last resort'; Sawa implies Kitahara was killed on orders.
U06199: 'He' = Captain Kato; 'Go' made explicit for clarity.
U06207-U06212: garbled conditions decoded (住て=全て, 宅獣=怪獣, 冗復が住改=味方が全滅).
U06213: 守り切れなかったとき rendered 'the dynamite factory cannot be defended'.
U06217: 艦識 read as 鑑識 (forensics team).
U06244: the female spy's 『』 inner thought rendered in double quotes; ウデスパー参謀 rendered 'Staff Officer Udesper' per the brief's rank rule.
